tooltip.darkspawn.ingredient_pouch.capac: Brewing reagents only. One bundle of capacity; no nested storage.
tooltip.darkspawn.ingredient_pouch.contr: Left-click to insert; right-click with an empty cursor to remove. Use in hand to drop contents.
message.darkspawn.ingredient_pouch.rejec: Only brewing reagents fit. Bottles, finished potions and containers do not.
